title: Img2Num — HTML + UMD (AMD/RequireJS) Example
description: Convert a raster image to SVG in the browser with Img2Num, loaded as an AMD module through RequireJS using the UMD bundle.
heading: Img2Num UMD Example Application
intro: A simple demo app showing how to use Img2Num's JavaScript library as an AMD module. RequireJS loads the UMD build from lib/, so nothing is added to the global scope.
loader:
<script src="{{REQUIRE_URL}}"></script>
<script>
  requirejs.config({ paths: { img2num: "{{LIB_URL}}" } });
  requirejs(["img2num"], ({ imageToUint8ClampedArray, imageToSvg }) => {
{{APP_CODE}}
  });
</script>
